# WA3 · Khung · Kế toán (trang chủ Thu ngân)

Group **WA · Khung & điều hướng** · state · Next.js: **restyle (U1)** (`(app shell)`) · account `accountant`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/staff-context.js#pages`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#shell`
- The shell is drawn once by `clinic.js › shell(content)`: `.sidebar` (menu filtered by `PemaStaff.allowed(page)`), `.topbar` (breadcrumbs, demo account picker, global search, bell, reset), then the page body.
- Accountant menu: Tài chính, Thu ngân, Tìm bệnh nhân, Hướng dẫn; capabilities `billing` and `readFinance`.
- Inventory note: Role shell: 4 nav items (patients, cashier, finance, guide), lands on cashier.
- Shown with account `accountant`; the screen is part of the shell or an overlay (no page key).
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"wait":".sidebar"}; it must show "Thu ngân".

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
<Button variant="secondary" href="#main-content" as="link" old="skip-link">"Đến nội dung chính"</Button>
<Sidebar old="sidebar" tag="aside">
  <Img alt="Pema clinic & spa" size="116x62" />
  <Text old="brand-context">"PHÒNG KHÁM DA LIỄU"</Text>
  <Text old="nav-section" transform="uppercase">"Không gian làm việc"</Text>
  <Sidebar.Item icon>"Tìm bệnh nhân"</Sidebar.Item>  // nav=patients
  <Text old="nav-section" transform="uppercase">"Quản lý"</Text>
  <Sidebar.Item active icon>"Thu ngân"</Sidebar.Item>  // nav=cashier
  <Sidebar.Item href="../clinic-web/?screen=finance&staff=accountant" icon>"Tài chính & tiền thủ thuật"</Sidebar.Item>  // nav=finance
  <Text old="nav-section" transform="uppercase">"Phân tích"</Text>
  <Sidebar.Item icon>"Hướng dẫn"</Sidebar.Item>  // nav=guide
  <Row old="clinic-user" gap="10px">
    <Avatar old="avatar">"Kt"</Avatar>
    <Text><Strong>"Kế toán"</Strong> <Small>"Đối soát & thu ngân"</Small></Text>
  </Row>
</Sidebar>
<TopBar old="topbar" justify="space-between">
  <Text old="breadcrumbs">"Không gian phòng khám" <Strong>"/"</Strong> <Strong>"Thu ngân"</Strong></Text>
  <Row old="top-actions" gap="12px">
    <Button variant="secondary" href="../finance/" title="Thu ngân web → dữ liệu tài chính và thông báo app" as="link">"Tài chính đã đồng bộ"</Button>
    <Field label="Tài khoản demo" type="select" default="Kế toán · Đối soát & thu ngân" id="staff-account" options={["BS. Tâm · Chủ phòng khám","BS. Tâm · Bác sĩ điều trị","BS. Mai · Bác sĩ điều trị","BS. An · Bác sĩ điều trị","BS. Lan · Bác sĩ điều trị","Mai Anh · CSKH","Thu · CSKH","Kế toán · Đối soát & thu ngân"]} />
    <Field label="Tìm kiếm bệnh nhân" type="text" placeholder="Tìm bệnh nhân..." id="global-search" />
    <Button variant="secondary" aria-label="Đặt lại dữ liệu demo" icon icon-only old="icon-btn"></Button>
  </Row>
</TopBar>
```
Kit components used: Sidebar×5, Button×3, Field×2, TopBar×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.
